verdict.rationale: Runtime probes show a live, auth-gated MCP endpoint on Reclaim's own domain (mcp.reclaim.ai). It answers MCP initialize with a per-spec OAuth Bearer challenge and publishes RFC 9728 resource metadata with read/write/mcp scopes, so a first-party MCP server exists. However, no vendor documentation for it was found, and its tools and behavior after authentication are unverified. Missing for 10: first-party docs for the MCP server, an evidenced tool list and capabilities, an authenticated end-to-end agent connection, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: a live, auth-gated MCP endpoint on the vendor's own domain speaking the per-spec MCP OAuth flow
